## Checklist

- [ ] Changeset added or updated when a published package's behavior, API, types, dependencies, engines, or published files changed. Docs, comments, tests, refactors, CI, and `packages/config` need none. Format is in `.changeset/README.md`
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior
- [ ] README updated when the public API changed
- [ ] Targets `develop` for stable work, or `beta` for an experiment. A breaking change uses the `Breaking` category and a migration snippet. A patch or minor fix for an older major targets `release/**`
- [ ] Package names and imports use the public `@sgx4u` scope
- [ ] Every `link:` or `file:` dependency resolves inside this repository
